The '''Nite Owls''' were an elite unit of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] within the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. During [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the unit was led by the [[Gender/Legends|female]] Mandalorian [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]], a trusted [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the Death Watch's leader, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]].

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Nite Owls were present on the planet [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] along with the rest of the Death Watch. They fought for the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] in the [[Battle on Carlac/Legends|First Skirmish on Carlac]].<ref name="AFiN" />
[[File:KatanNiteOwls-TL.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]] and two [[Gender/Legends|female]] members of the Nite Owls]]
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the Nite Owls would participate in the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover of Mandalore]] with the rest of the Death Watch. They split apart from the Death Watch after the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] killed [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Vizsla]] and proclaimed himself the Death Watch leader. Refusing to recognize an outsider as her superior, [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] fled with the Nite Owls.<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>

The Nite Owls allied themselves with [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine's]] loyalists led by her nephew [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie]], and they attempted to break the former [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] from [[Royal prison/Legends|prison]] in order to send a message to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] for help against Maul. During the break out, the Nite Owls and loyalists were engaged by several members of Maul's Death Watch loyalists as they attempted to take Satine out of the city of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. They were ultimately overwhelmed, and Satine was recaptured, but the members of the squad escaped.<ref name="Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

[[File:NiteOwlsAndKenobi-TheLawless.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Nite Owls fight alongside Kenobi]]
Kenobi would soon come to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and free her himself, but they were stopped while they were trying to escape, and Satine was executed. As Kenobi was being taken to prison, Bo-Katan and the Nite Owls rescued him. This began the [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|Battle of Sundari]], with the Nite Owls and Kenobi on one side, and the [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]] on the other. Eventually, Bo-Katan and Kenobi fought their way to a starship, and Kenobi left to inform the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] of the situation on Mandalore.<ref name="Lawless" />

==Equipment==
The Nite Owls equipment was similar to that of the rest of Death Watch wearing a set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], comprising of several individual plates colored in both metallic gray and blue. Even though each of their armor had unique symbols on them they all used the same type of weaponry equipped to their armor including dart launchers, blasters and possibly hidden blades within their gauntlets as well as a [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord launcher]] and a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] for flight.<ref name="AFiN" />

The group was also able to gain control of two [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transports]] to carry their group into battle once they were most likely either abandoned or stolen from the former Death Watch Members.<ref name="AFiN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although the [http://starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep414/#!/about trivia gallery] for "[[A Friend in Need]]" originally referred to the group as the "'''Night Owls''',"<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'' listed them as the "Nite Owls,"<ref name="DM:SC">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref> which was reflected in the episode guides for their [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five]] appearances.<ref name="The Lawless Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-lawless-episode-guide|text="The Lawless" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
